decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a functional and durable backpack for outdoor activities. My consideration set covers a range of specialized bags: a high-end technical hiking pack (Osprey), a specialized winter adventure pack (USWE), a casual sling bag (MOSISO), a waterproof dry bag (IDRYBAG), and an insulated cooler backpack (Scothen). The Osprey and USWE packs are top-tier but very expensive for a casual purchase. The cooler backpack and sling bag are useful but narrower in scope. I decided to purchase the IDRYBAG Waterproof Backpack because of its exceptional 4.6 rating, specifically a review highlighting its durability after a year of use, and its very affordable price point for a specialized waterproof item.
